subject.title: Inconsistent message:sent / message_sent hook coverage across multiple outbound dispatch paths

question: Should OpenClaw guarantee `message_sending`, `message_sent`, and internal `message:sent` semantics for every user-visible outbound path, and if so where is the canonical observer/reporting boundary?
rationale: The remaining work affects plugin guardrails, audit/session state, streaming rewrite/cancel behavior, and plugin SDK surface; automation should not choose those semantics piecemeal.

options.title: Approve canonical outbound observer seam
options.body: Define one owner boundary plus a narrow plugin SDK reporting seam so every path emits or reports through the same lifecycle contract with exactly-once tests.

options.title: Land narrow per-surface repairs
options.body: Accept focused fixes for individual channels and Gateway paths, but maintainers should explicitly own the drift and double-run risk.

options.title: Document limited guarantees
options.body: If universal coverage is not intended, update public hook docs with a supported-path matrix and close or split the remaining implementation work accordingly.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical outbound observer seam
recommendation.body: Define one owner boundary plus a narrow plugin SDK reporting seam so every path emits or reports through the same lifecycle contract with exactly-once tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans merged outbound hook work, plugin SDK compatibility, and security-sensitive channel delivery semantics that recent merged PRs route through steipete.
